documents.title: SENTINEL demo rack profiles
documents.content: Rack profile thresholds (temperature_warning_c, temperature_critical_c, humidity_*_percent) are fictional settings created for the SENTINEL hackathon demo. They are not manufacturer specifications and are not derived from any vendor documentation.

documents.title: SENTINEL rover sensor notes
documents.content: The rover measures ambient temperature and relative humidity near the rack, raw sound intensity (SOUND_RAW, an uncalibrated microphone level, not decibels), and ultrasonic distance in cm to the nearest surface in front of the sensor. Rover ambient temperature is not equipment inlet or component temperature. The rover cannot read fan RPM, CPU utilization, power draw, interface errors, or hardware health.

documents.title: Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches Hardware Installation Guide — Product Overview

technical_facts.statement: A steady green System LED denotes normal system operation; blinking green denotes software loading.
An amber System LED denotes powered but improper operation; the table names fan failure or POST failure as possible reasons.

limitations: Requires identifying the System LED, its temporal state, exact installed model, and operating mode. A static photograph cannot establish blinking.
This does not apply to an arbitrary port LED or confirm the selected rack has a fan or POST failure.

documents.title: Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches Hardware Installation Guide — Preparing for Installation
documents.section: Installation Guidelines; Site Requirements / Air Flow

technical_facts.statement: Keep ventilation openings unobstructed and avoid feeding another device exhaust into the switch intake.
The Air Flow section recommends 15 cm between a wall and chassis or PSU intakes/exhausts, and 30.5 cm between one chassis intake and another chassis exhaust in adjacent racks.

limitations: Clearance is a site-layout recommendation, not a conclusion obtainable from one rover distance reading.
Rover ambient readings do not establish inlet temperature, airflow, or installation compliance.

documents.title: Dell EMC PowerEdge R7425 — Technical specifications

technical_facts.statement: Standard continuous operation is 10–35 °C below 950 m altitude, with no direct sunlight. Maximum supported temperature is reduced at higher altitude; configuration restrictions and expanded operation are separate.
Operating relative humidity is 10–80% with a maximum dew point of 29 °C.

limitations: Do not apply standard limits without checking altitude and the actual server configuration.
A rover ambient reading is not a verified server inlet measurement; humidity alone does not establish dew point or condensation. No compliance verdict is supported.

documents.title: HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen11 QuickSpecs
documents.section: Technical Specifications, pp. 79–80 / Relative Humidity; System Inlet Temperature

technical_facts.statement: Standard inlet operation is 10–35 °C at sea level, derated by 1 °C per 305 m to 3050 m; installed options may lower the upper limit or permitted rate of change.
Operating relative humidity is 8–90%, non-condensing, with a 28 °C maximum wet-bulb temperature.

limitations: Check the installed options and approved configuration before applying limits; extended operation is not assumed.
A rover ambient reading does not establish system inlet temperature, wet-bulb temperature, or condensation. No automatic manufacturer-compliance assessment.

documents.title: Dell PowerEdge R760 Installation and Service Manual — Environmental specifications
documents.section: Tables 1–4: Continuous Operation Specifications for ASHRAE A2, A3, A4; Common Environmental Specifications

technical_facts.statement: ASHRAE A2 continuous operation: 10–35 °C for altitudes ≤ 900 m, with no direct sunlight on the equipment; maximum temperature reduced by 1 °C/300 m above 900 m.
ASHRAE A3: 5–40 °C (35–40 °C limited to 10% annual runtime). ASHRAE A4: 5–45 °C (35–40 °C 10% and 40–45 °C 1% annual runtime).
ASHRAE A2 humidity: 8% RH with −12 °C minimum dew point to 80% RH with 21 °C maximum dew point, non-condensing at all times.
Maximum temperature gradient: 20 °C in an hour and 5 °C in 15 minutes (operation and non-operation).

limitations: Documented limits are for server inlet air; a rover ambient reading near the rack is not a verified inlet measurement.
Check altitude, installed options and the approved configuration before applying any limit; no compliance verdict is supported.
Extended (A3/A4) operation applies only to configurations that support it.
applicability_conditions: Exact manufacturer and supported model must be explicitly identified for this rack.
Documented ranges are reference context; they become alert thresholds only if the operator applies them to the rack's profile.

documents.title: HPE ProLiant DL360 Gen11 Server User Guide — Environmental specifications
documents.section: Environmental specifications (temperature range, relative humidity, footnote 1)

technical_facts.statement: Operating 10–35 °C at sea level; altitude derating 1.0 °C per 304.8 m to 3048 m; no direct sunlight; maximum rate of change 20 °C per hour; the upper limit and rate of change might be limited by installed options.
For certain approved hardware configurations the supported system inlet range is extended to 5–10 °C and 35–40 °C, and to 40–45 °C, each with its own altitude derating above 900 m.
Operating relative humidity (non-condensing): minimum the higher of −12 °C dew point or 8% RH; maximum 24 °C dew point or 90% RH.

limitations: Documented limits are for server inlet air; a rover ambient reading near the rack is not a verified inlet measurement.
Check altitude, installed options and the approved configuration before applying any limit; no compliance verdict is supported.
Extended ranges apply only to the approved hardware configurations listed by HPE.
